name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-applicant-disposition
_comment: Request Workbench Phase 0 (S208). One local picklist tagging an applicant-sourced engagement row. null (the normal case) = staff/Claude-discovered candidate; 'recommended'/'excluded' carry the applicant's intent for THIS request only — the disposition lives solely on the junction, never on the global wmkf_potentialreviewer person, so a person excluded by one applicant stays eligible for every other request. 'excluded' rows are also written wmkf_selected=false and filtered from all candidate/count readers via notExcludedFilter() (lib/dataverse/adapters/reviewer-suggestion.js). DefaultFormValue -1 keeps the unset value null. Idempotent: ensureAttribute checks existence before create. Deploy: node scripts/apply-dataverse-schema.js --target=prod --wave=6 --execute

attributes.description: Applicant-stated intent for this reviewer on this request. Blank = candidate found by staff/Claude (the normal case). Recommended = the applicant suggested this reviewer. Excluded = the applicant asked us not to use this reviewer. Per-request only — never marks the person globally.

options.label: Recommended
options.description: Applicant recommended this reviewer for this request.

options.label: Excluded
options.description: Applicant asked that this reviewer not be used for this request.
